text:
10. 1. 4. 2

Pātimokkhaṭṭhapana suttaṃ

(Sāvatthi)

Kati nu kho bhante pātimokkhaṭṭhapanānīti?

Dasa kho upāli pātimokkhaṭṭhapanā katame dasa: pārājiko tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, pārājikakathā vippakatā hoti, anupasampanno tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, anupasampannakathā vippakatā hoti, sikkhaṃ paccakkhātako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, sikkhaṃ paccakkhātakathā vippakatā hoti, paṇḍako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, paṇḍakakathā vippakatā hoti, bhikkhunīdūsako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, bhikkhunīdūsakakathā vippakathā hoti. Ime kho upāli dasa pātimokkhaṭṭhapanāti.
